name: A match's or a model's comments
description: ONE HOST'S THREAD: `?match=` or `?model=`, exactly one. Twenty top-level comments a page, newest first, each with all its replies oldest first -- they share its root_id, so the page is one indexed read -- with the thread's live count, whether it is locked, and a keyset cursor on (created_at, id). THE PUBLIC SEES LIVE COMMENTS ONLY: a held one is its author's (GET /v1/me/comments, which web places in the thread), and a removed or deleted one stays as a placeholder with no author and no text only while a live comment hangs beneath it. A match nobody may see (match_public) answers 404 like one that does not exist, so a trial in progress has no thread in public. `thread_id` is null until the host's first comment. Cached under hot_cache: the page re-reads every thirty seconds, and a new comment shows within the TTL.
